item: 1 Drive module subframe and preload springs
spec: 6 mm steel plate clamp to the donor steering yoke, trailing side cheeks, two compression springs giving about 1.1 kN adjustable preload on the drive wheels
notes: Indicative price; clamp pattern depends on the donor yoke (open question); bolt-on only

spec: 24 V brushless hub servo motor, 200 mm (8 in) wheel with rubber or polyurethane tread, about 250 W rated, about 17 N m peak needed, encoder, fail-safe brake
notes: Indicative price per motor; peak torque and brake holding torque to be confirmed from a datasheet at TRL 3

spec: Folded 1.5 mm steel or aluminium box 280 x 300 x 170 mm with lid, cable glands, IP54
8S 25.6 V 20 Ah (512 Wh) LiFePO4, BMS with 50 A continuous discharge, charge temperature cut-off
notes: Indicative price; about 410 Wh usable at 80 % depth of discharge

spec: 24 V dual-channel brushless servo driver, 2 x 15 A continuous, CAN or RS-485, brake outputs
notes: Indicative price; sold as a pair with the hub motors by some suppliers

spec: 80 A main fuse, 24 V main contactor with pre-charge resistor, lockable battery disconnect
ESP32-S3 class controller with CAN transceiver and UWB SPI links; dual-channel safety relay for the stop chain
notes: Indicative price (controller about $25; safety relay about $60); firmware is not TRL 2 work

spec: Clamp-on head replacing the grip: thumbwheel throttle, belly-reverse paddle, mode key switch (walk or follow), horn button
notes: Indicative price; generic walkie tiller-head parts

spec: 22 mm red mushroom pushbutton, twist release, two normally closed contacts, yellow backing plate (ISO 13850 style)
notes: Indicative price per unit; one on the tiller head and one on the enclosure lid

spec: Pressure-sensitive safety edge about 1.3 m long on a steel U hoop, with evaluation unit, about 40 mm compression travel
notes: Indicative price; last-resort stop only (see PLP-PRC-001)

spec: Qorvo DWM3000 class UWB module on a carrier board, two on the bumper corners (about 450 mm baseline), one on the tiller head
24 V LED beacon, amber in walk mode and blue in follow mode, with travel buzzer
Over-center lever that lifts the drive wheels clear of the floor and releases the brakes for pushing by hand
Certified 29.2 V 5 A LiFePO4 charger, 100 to 240 V AC input
Belt or wrist tag with UWB module, rechargeable cell, stop button and vibration alert
